title: test(app-shell): serve the Data pillar grid an empty DataSource and fail on an absorbed fetch error
body:
Fixes #8620
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

The suites that render the Data pillar's records grid mocked `useAdapter` as `() => ({})`, an object with no `find()`. The pillar passes the adapter through `PluginObjectView` to `ListView`, whose fetch effect called `dataSource.find(...)` and threw. `ListView`'s best-effort `catch` swallowed the TypeError. It logged `ListView data fetch error: TypeError: dataSource.find is not a function`, rendered its load-error panel, and the test went on. No assertion read that path, so every one of these suites was green while printing the same error on every run.

The shared mock was not a module. The same `vi.mock('@object-ui/react', …)` factory was repeated in each file.

## What this changes (test-only, no product source)

- **New `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/__tests__/emptyDataSource.ts`** with two exports:
  - `createEmptyDataSource()` is an empty-backend adapter typed against the published `DataSource` contract from `@object-ui/types`, so a new required member breaks the build instead of drifting. `find` resolves `{ data: [] }`, and `findOne` and `getObjectSchema` resolve `null`. A `null` schema is how both `ListView` and `useSettledSchema` settle when there is no schema, so the render path matches the old one apart from the fetch now succeeding. A *rejecting* `getObjectSchema` would have logged a different absorbed error from `useSettledSchema`. `create` / `update` / `delete` reject with an error that names the double. The double does not model writes, so it cannot hand back a success nobody wrote.
  - `failOnAbsorbedFetchError()` registers a `beforeEach`/`afterEach` pair. It puts a **pass-through** `vi.spyOn(console, 'error')` on each test (no mock implementation, so every line still prints) and in `afterEach` fails **only** on a call whose first argument matches `/\bdata fetch error:/`. That prefix is shared by the two producers, `ListView`'s and `ObjectView`'s fetch `catch`. It is the same record-then-assert-in-`afterEach` shape as the network-escape guard (objectui#6640). It also checks that the spy is still installed when `afterEach` reads it. A `vi.restoreAllMocks()` in a file's own teardown would otherwise clear the record and let the pin pass on nothing.
- **The seven carriers** now return one module-scope `createEmptyDataSource()` instance from `useAdapter`, so the adapter keeps the same identity across renders (the objectui#4567 convention `StudioDesignSurface.gridColumns.test.tsx` already follows). Each file also registers the pin before its own hooks.
- `.changeset/8620-datapillar-test-empty-adapter.md`: empty frontmatter. The presence gate asked for it: the 8 touched files are under `src/` of a released package.
- AGENTS.md #11 repair in a touched file: `StudioDesignSurface.designerRegistryMissing.test.tsx` cited a `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` line number that had drifted. It now names the `flowStatus` effect instead.

⛔ Not changed: `ListView`'s `catch`, any product source, and `console.error` globally.

## Evidence

⚠️ **How to count the lines in an agent session.** Vitest 4.1 picks the `agent` reporter (`MinimalReporter`) when the `AI_AGENT` env var is set. That reporter drops console output from passing tests. So `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` shows **zero** `dataSource.find` lines in an agent session whether or not the defect is present. Every count below comes from the same command with `--reporter=default` added.

Per-file `dataSource.find is not a function` lines, directory run from the repo root:

| file | base `d9996170d` | head `8c67a173c` |
|---|---|---|
| `DataPillar.celGate` | 5 | 0 |
| `DataPillar.designerRegistryPopulated` | 7 | 0 |
| `DataPillar.layoutBadge` | 7 | 0 |
| `DataPillar.panelGate` | 6 | 0 |
| `DataPillar.savedAtDisplayLocale-10232` | 6 | 0 |
| `DataPillar.surfaceRequest` | 19 | 0 |
| `StudioDesignSurface.designerRegistryMissing` | 1 | 0 |
| `DataPillar.gridProjection` | 0 | not touched (mocks `ObjectView`, so `ListView` never mounts) |
| `StudioDesignSurface.pillarNavGuard` | 0 | not touched (no `useAdapter` mock; renders the Access pillar, not the grid) |

Both runs: `Test Files 61 passed (61)`, `Tests 347 passed (347)`. The zero after the fix is a real reading: the same head run still prints its other stderr, 69 `stderr |` blocks (act() and i18next warnings), so the reporter was showing console output.

**Ablation (the pin can fail).** `useAdapter: () => dataSource` was put back to `useAdapter: () => ({})` in all seven carriers at once, through `ablation-replace.mjs` in nested wrap mode, from the committed head `8c67a173c`. Each mutation was proven on disk: anchor count 1 to 0, and the blob changed. Result: `Test Files 7 failed (7)`, `Tests 20 failed | 3 passed (23)`. All 20 failures are the pin's own assertion (`a view absorbed a data-fetch error in its best-effort catch…`, with the absorbed `ListView data fetch error: TypeError: dataSource.find is not a function` lines in the diff). The 3 passes are `StudioDesignSurface.designerRegistryMissing`'s Automations and Interfaces cases, which never mount the grid. That is the pin passing on everything except the absorbed line. All seven files were restored and checked: blob equals the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

**Ablation (the liveness self-check can fail).** Changing `DataPillar.layoutBadge`'s `afterEach(cleanup)` to also call `vi.restoreAllMocks()` turned 4/4 tests red with `the absorbed-fetch-error spy was replaced before afterEach could read it…`. The file was restored and checked: blob equals HEAD.

**Reverse type check (the `DataSource` typing is live).** After `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2` (28/28 tasks), I deleted `getObjectSchema` from the double. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` then reported `error TS2741: Property 'getObjectSchema' is missing in type … but required in type 'DataSource[any]'`. The type is written with brackets here because this body strips angle-bracket spans. Restored and checked: blob equals HEAD.

## Gates run locally (on `8c67a173c`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run --reporter=default packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/`: 61/61 files, 347/347 tests.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, after building the closure above): exit 0.
- ESLint on the 8 touched `.ts`/`.tsx` files, `--no-inline-config --format json`: 8 files, 0 errors, 8 warnings. All 8 warnings are the same `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` on pre-existing lines in `celGate` (4) and `panelGate` (4). The base blobs linted by stdin at the same paths give the same per-rule counts, and the new helper has 0/0. Why checking only these files is enough: `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService` (so linting is not type-aware), and no local rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the disk. So this diff cannot change the verdict on any file it does not touch.
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-changeset-presence` (empty-frontmatter declaration accepted), `check-changeset-claims` / `-fixed` / `-no-major` / `-overwrite`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:published-tsconfig-exclude`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check-lint-coverage`: all exit 0.
- `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the 9 paths: NOT GOVERNED.

## Acceptance notes

- **Other output left in these suites (listed, not widened):** React `act(...)` warnings in `celGate` (`CelPredicateField`, `ObjectFormDesigner`, `DataPillar`) and `panelGate` (`CelPredicateField`, `ObjectValidationsPanel`, `DataPillar`), and one `react-i18next` `NO_I18NEXT_INSTANCE` warning per file. Neither is an absorbed fetch error. One side effect of the fix: `surfaceRequest`'s `An update to ListView … not wrapped in act(...)` warning is gone, because it came from the error-state update.
- The `agent`-reporter behaviour above hits any agent that measures console output with the plain `vitest run` form. That is an observation about vitest's defaults, not a defect in this repo. It is noted here and not filed.
- `useAdapter: () => ({})` is still used by other suites (list them with `git grep -l "useAdapter: () => ({})" -- packages apps`). At head that gives 15 in `studio-design` and 8 elsewhere in `app-shell`. Every `studio-design` one printed 0 absorbed lines in the base directory run above. Whether the ones outside `studio-design` absorb anything is **NOT MEASURED**. That is the card's third open question, and it is outside the card's scope.

Session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC` (`domain:ui` seat 1 dispatch, `os-dev`).
